item.title: In India, police shootings of alleged cow smugglers raise alarm about impunity and bias
item.description: An Associated Press investigation found that police in India's most populous state have repeatedly shot suspects in the leg, many of them Muslims accused of cow smuggling.

item.title: Trump administration stopped sharing evidence in Good and Pretti killings, Minnesota officials say
item.description: State officials say in court filings that the federal government has stopped sharing evidence with Minnesota authorities who are investigating the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti by federal officers.

item.title: Photos show festival on Myanmar's Inle Lake after the end of monsoon
item.description: INLE LAKE, Myanmar (AP) — A few days after the monsoon rains subside, Inle Lake, nestled among picturesque mountains, becomes the setting for one of Myanmar’s most important Buddhist festivals as sacred golden images glide across the water.
